answer: Concretely, the economy can anchor each identity to a chain event only an independent operator could cite. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its yarrow recurs, its vine survives audit, and a plume from an unlinked peer confirms it.
